## Objective
This script is to keep track of files to process and processed for the qupath model tissue_vs_glass

### Input
- subset_<subset_name>.json (fe_si_images/output/process_subset)
### Output
- paths_vs_dnn.(fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/file_paths_for_qupath)


```{r}

subset_path_vs_dnn <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_path_vs_dnn_sample.json")

tissue_vs_glass_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/export_tissue/"

all_tissue_vs_glass_files <- basename(list.files(tissue_vs_glass_dir, full.names = FALSE))

tissue_vs_glass_image_names <- subset_path_vs_dnn$image_name[
  sapply(subset_path_vs_dnn$image_name, function(name) {
    any(startsWith(all_tissue_vs_glass_files, name))
  })
]

process_tissue_vs_glass <- subset_path_vs_dnn %>% filter(!(image_name %in% tissue_vs_glass_image_names))


file_paths <- process_tissue_vs_glass$file_path



writeLines(file_paths, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/tissue_vs_glass/output/ file_paths_for_qupath/paths_vs_dnn.txt")
```
